name: Noodle Biomedical Literature Discovery MCP
description: Open-source public MCP adapter for Noodle by Helena Bioinformatics. It lets agents search a public PubMed-derived biomedical corpus, retrieve source-linked records, and traverse bounded citation and semantic literature neighborhoods. The hosted server is read-only, requires no account or API key, accepts no patient or private data, and does not provide diagnosis, treatment, or causal conclusions.

owner.name: Helena Bioinformatics
owner.description: Bulgarian bioinformatics company building free, source-linked scientific infrastructure for researchers and qualified professionals.
